signature: SUBROUTINE ZGEEVX( BALANC, JOBVL, JOBVR, SENSE, N, A, LDA, W, VL,

params.name: balanc
jobvl
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: left eigenvectors of A are not computed;
-   `= 'V'`: left eigenvectors of A are computed. If `SENSE = 'E'` or 'B', `JOBVL` must = 'V'.

params.name: jobvr
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: right eigenvectors of A are not computed;
-   `= 'V'`: right eigenvectors of A are computed. If `SENSE = 'E'` or 'B', `JOBVR` must = 'V'.

params.name: sense
N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the N-by-N matrix A. On exit, A has been overwritten. If `JOBVL = 'V'` or `JOBVR = 'V'`, A contains the Schur form of the balanced version of the matrix A.
params.workDependent: the Schur form T is unique only up to unit phases, which the LWORK-dependent Hessenberg blocking can change

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: w
params.reference: W contains the computed eigenvalues.

params.name: VL
params.reference: If `JOBVL = 'V'`, the left eigenvectors u(j) are stored one after another in the columns of `VL`, in the same order as their eigenvalues. If `JOBVL = 'N'`, `VL` is not referenced. $u(j) = \mathrm{VL}(:,j)$, the j-th column of `VL`.

params.name: ldvl
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `VL`. $\mathrm{LDVL} \ge 1$; if `JOBVL = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDVL} \ge N$.

params.name: VR
params.reference: If `JOBVR = 'V'`, the right eigenvectors v(j) are stored one after another in the columns of `VR`, in the same order as their eigenvalues. If `JOBVR = 'N'`, `VR` is not referenced. $v(j) = \mathrm{VR}(:,j)$, the j-th column of `VR`.

params.name: ldvr
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `VR`. $\mathrm{LDVR} \ge 1$; if `JOBVR = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDVR} \ge N$.

params.name: ihi
params.reference: `ILO` and `IHI` are integer values determined when A was balanced. The balanced $A(i,j) = 0$ if $I > J$ and $J = 1$,...,`ILO`-1 or $I = \mathrm{IHI}+1$,...,N.

params.name: SCALE
params.reference:
Details of the permutations and scaling factors applied when balancing A. If P(j) is the index of the row and column interchanged with row and column j, and D(j) is the scaling factor applied to row and column j, then

```text
SCALE(J) = P(J),    for J = 1,...,ILO-1
         = D(J),    for J = ILO,...,IHI
         = P(J)     for J = IHI+1,...,N.
```

The order in which the interchanges are made is N to `IHI`+1, then 1 to `ILO`-1.

params.name: abnrm
params.reference: The one-norm of the balanced matrix (the maximum of the sum of absolute values of elements of any column).

params.name: RCONDE
params.reference: `RCONDE(j)` is the reciprocal condition number of the j-th eigenvalue.

params.name: RCONDV
params.reference: `RCONDV(j)` is the reciprocal condition number of the j-th right eigenvector.
params.workDependent: ZTRSNA's estimate is computed from the Schur form, whose phases the LWORK-dependent Hessenberg blocking can change

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`. If `SENSE = 'N'` or 'E', $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,2 \, N)$, and if `SENSE = 'V'` or 'B', $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge N \, N+2 \, N$. For good performance, `LWORK` must generally be larger.

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, the QR algorithm failed to compute all the eigenvalues, and no eigenvectors or condition numbers have been computed; elements 1:`ILO`-1 and i+1:N of W contain eigenvalues which have converged.

checks.fortran: .NOT.( LSAME( BALANC, 'N' ) .OR. LSAME( BALANC, 'S' ) .OR. LSAME( BALANC, 'P' ) .OR. LSAME( BALANC, 'B' ) )
.NOT.( WNTSNN .OR. WNTSNE .OR. WNTSNB .OR. WNTSNV ) .OR. ( ( WNTSNE .OR. WNTSNB ) .AND. .NOT.( WANTVL .AND. WANTVR ) )

untranslated: WORK.minLength: local MINWRK is assigned inside nested control flow

overrides.reason: ZGEEVX hands its LWORK to ZGEHRD, ZUNGHR, ZHSEQR and ZTREVC3, which pick their block size, AED window or back-transformation from LWORK. The blocked and unblocked Hessenberg reductions round differently, and the QR iteration that follows reaches a Schur form T (in A) that is unique only up to unit phases of its off-diagonal entries; ZTRSNA's RCONDV is ZLACN2's estimate on that T, so it moves with it. The reference does this as well past its ZGEHRD crossover (ILAENV(3) = 128; compiled LAPACK 3.12.0 ZGEEV, which shares this path, returns a different A at LWORK = 2N than at its optimum for N = 150, 200 and 300). The JS zgehrd crosses over at NX = 32, so the JS path changes from N > 33. At N = 40, W, VL, VR (normalized), RCONDE, SCALE and ABNRM agree to rounding; the module's tests check W and RCONDE, and RCONDV within a factor 2, at the minimum WORK past the blocking threshold (ticket 0100).

set.params.A.workDependent: the Schur form T is unique only up to unit phases, which the LWORK-dependent Hessenberg blocking can change
set.params.RCONDV.workDependent: ZTRSNA's estimate is computed from the Schur form, whose phases the LWORK-dependent Hessenberg blocking can change
